name: pawl-root
description: Fast guardrails for AI-written code. One standard, compiled for Biome and ESLint.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run build && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js check
scripts.check:generated: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run preset && pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run docs:rules && git diff --exit-code -- packages/pawl/presets apps/docs/src/content/docs/reference/rules.md
scripts.fix: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run build && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js fix
scripts.ok: turbo run build typecheck test && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js check && pnpm run lint:spell && pnpm run lint:knip && pnpm run check:generated
scripts.pre-commit: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint:spell
scripts.release: turbo run build test && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js check && changeset publish
